purpose: Teach: 金儲け/とことん/さりげ/ガンガン/ハゲ/音量/見物/ねらい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店は金儲けだけじゃない、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, running a café is about more than just making money.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Gentle conviction underlying the words. A pause before speaking, like choosing what matters to say. Warm, not preachy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、とことん試作したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I've tested this new menu so thoroughly — every version, every detail.
lines.style: Bright energy, a little proud. Words tumble out with genuine enthusiasm. Quick pace. The warmth of someone sharing something they've poured care into.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、さりげない気遣いに感動されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customers notice the little things you do for them. It moves them.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Speaking from having watched and understood something true. Gentle emphasis on 'moves' — like she's witnessed something real. Almost intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お隣のお店、ガンガン宣伝してるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the shop next door is really pushing their ads hard, aren't they.
lines.style: Slightly concerned observation. Not worried, but noticing. Thoughtful pause. The tone of someone thinking through what it means, not just stating facts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の写真、ハゲ部分があっても気にしないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when customers share photos with you, don't worry if they're not perfect — that's not what matters.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance. Quiet confidence in what she's saying. A soft correction wrapped in care, not judgment. Speaking from kindness, not instruction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、BGMの音量、お客様に確認しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, maybe check with customers about the background music volume before assuming it's right.
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered warmly. Not critical — collaborative. A small smile in the voice. The tone of someone who wants to help, not correct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの試食会、見物のお客様、多かったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, so many people came just to watch the new menu tasting — it was wonderful.
lines.style: Bright, warm reflection. A little amazed by the turnout. Speaking with genuine delight, like she's still processing how well it went. The energy is lifting.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、キャンペーンのねらいは新規開拓よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the real point of a campaign like this is bringing in new customers, right.
lines.style: Practical, assured tone. A gentle question that's already half-answered. Speaking as an equal thinking through strategy together. No edge, just clarity.
